title: Dutch Pancake Delight
description: A classic Dutch pancake recipe with a fluffy and warm texture, perfect for a cold morning.

ingredients.name: all-purpose flour
ingredients.notes: Use high-quality flour for the best texture

ingredients.name: milk
ingredients.notes: Whole milk is preferred for richness

ingredients.name: eggs
ingredients.notes: Room temperature eggs for better mixing

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.notes: Use kosher salt for best flavor

instructions: 1. In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, yeast, and salt.
2. In a separate bowl, whisk together milk, eggs, and melted butter.
3. Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until just combined.
4. Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until smooth and elastic.
5. Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and let rise in a warm place for 1 hour, or until doubled in size.
6. Preheat a non-stick skillet or Dutch oven over medium heat.
7. Once hot, add a small amount of butter or oil to the pan.
8. Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the dough into the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until bubbles appear on the surface and the edges start to dry.
9. Loosen the pancake with a spatula and flip over. Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, or until golden brown.
10. Serve warm with your favorite toppings, such as powdered sugar, fresh fruit, or whipped cream.
